nodes.statement: The case A0=(8,32), (m,n)=(3,2), max=120 (degree pair (120,80)) is impossible: (rho1,sigma1)=(4,-1), en_{4,-1}(F1)=(6,21)=(3/4)A1, q1=4, d0<=4, so l_{1,0}(P)=R^{4m}=(lP x^2 y^7 (y-l1))^{4m}; after phi: y -> y+l1 the last possible corner of phi(P) would be (8,4), which is impossible by [2, Proposition 3.29].
